in_marathi.name: Vivan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vivan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vivan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vivaan', which means 'lively' or 'vibrant'. This name is perfect for a child who is full of energy and zest for life.
